svg.title: EventMesh event-driven architecture
svg.desc: Event-driven architecture for Apache EventMesh: event producers publish via HTTP, TCP, or gRPC runtime servers; EventMesh runtime routes events through pluggable storage and message backends; subscribed consumers receive asynchronous event delivery. Producers and consumers are fully decoupled.
